;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A [[Taliban]] suicide bomber kills three [[Czech Republic|Czech]] soldiers on a routine patrol in [[Charikar]], [[Afghanistan]]. A [[United States|U.S.]] soldier and two Afghan troops are also injured in the bombing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-45074383 (BBC)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Media of Syria|Syrian media]] reports that [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] has executed one of a number of [[Druze people in Syria|Druze]] hostages taken from [[Syria]]'s government-held city of [[As-Suwayda]] in an attack [[2018 As-Suwayda attacks|last week]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/syria/isis-executes-hostage-in-syria-1.6342217 (''Haaretz'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[5 August 2018 Lombok earthquake|August 2018 Lombok earthquake]]
**A 7.0 magnitude [[earthquake]] strikes [[Lombok]], [[Indonesia]]. A tsunami warning is issued. At least 131 people are killed and more than 238 are injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-45081508 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Ju-Air Junkers Ju 52 crash]]
**Police in [[Switzerland]] say that all 20 occupants of a [[World War II]]-era [[Junkers Ju 52]] plane that crashed yesterday on the flanks of the [[Piz Segnas]] mountain are dead. [http://www.whig.com/article/20180805/AP/308059949# (''Whig'')]
*[[New Mexico State Police|Police]] in [[New Mexico]] rescue 11 malnourished children being kept in squalid conditions in a remote desert compound. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45079090 (BBC)]
*Five people are killed after a small plane crashes in a [[Southern California]] parking lot. [http://time.com/5358271/plane-crash-southern-california/ (''Time'')]

;International relations
*[[Canada–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] withdraws its Ambassador from [[Canada]], and orders the Canadian counterpart to leave the country in 24 hours, after Canada calls for the release of activists who are in detention in the Middle East nation. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/saudi-arabia-suspends-trade-canada-ambassador-1.4775133 (CBC News)]
